title: Knights In Medieval Times
description: A ModPack focused on medieval combat and exploration.
body:
Suggested by TennyStartbase, member of my Discord community, so,\
feel free to join and suggest your ideas.

In this ModPack, you will feel like you're in the medieval times,\
with medieval **tools**, **weapons**, **armor** and more, it is a really immersive expirience.

Explore like never before, with medieval themed structures,\
this is the best ModPack for this theme.\
It is a very optimized and lightweight ModPack so,\
it should be able to run on any java-supporting device.

Features:

1. Medieval Tools
2. Medieval Weapons
3. Medieval Armor
4. Medieval Shields
5. Medieval Structures
6. Shader Support
7. Good Terrain Genaration
8. Amazing Views

For any help or bug reports, join my discord using this link: https://discord.gg/C9b3anUaP9
